meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 motion-graphics 技能，为你的需求制作短视频动态图形：自动规划、搜素材、设计画面、生成代码并渲染成 MP4 或透明视频。常见产出包括文字动画、数字增长、图表动效、logo 动画、地图演示、网页/UI 动效等，通常 10 秒内，无旁白。
howto.when: 当你要求做一个短的、以运动本身为内容的动态图形，如文字动画、数字统计、图表等，而不是长视频或带旁白的故事时，该技能接管。若需求更长、有旁白或多场景，会转给 /general-video；不确定则走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用一个数字从 0 涨到 100 万，做 5 秒动画
say.note: 会生成统计数字增长的动态图形。

say.text: 把这段新闻标题做成带标注的动效
say.note: 会生成新闻标题动画，配来源卡片和关键信息标注。

say.text: 给我的 logo 做一个 3 秒的开场动画
say.note: 会生成 logo 品牌展示动画。

howto.what_en: Claude creates short, design-led motion graphics: plans, sources assets, designs, builds, verifies, and renders MP4 or transparent video. Covers kinetic type, stats, charts, logos, maps, web/UI motion; under 10s, no narration.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a short motion graphic—kinetic type, stat count-up, chart, logo sting, map, etc.—rather than a narrated/long video. Longer or multi-scene requests route to /general-video; unclear ones to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Animate a number counting from 0 to 1M in 5 seconds.
Turn this news headline into an animated graphic with callouts.
say_en.note: Creates an animated news card with source and key facts.

say_en.text: Make a 3-second logo sting for my logo.
